## Verdict

wrong

## Bearer

ProfileRepository — core-domain/src/main/kotlin/com/mgilli/core/domain/profile/ProfileRepository.kt
(fulfilled by ProfileRepositoryImpl — core-data/src/main/kotlin/com/mgilli/core/data/profile/ProfileRepositoryImpl.kt:108-115)

## Trigger

profileDao.observe() raising while collected inside ProfileRepositoryImpl.observe() —
observed (the `.catch` at line 114 already reacts to it; it just discards
the failure instead of emitting it)

## Today

`ProfileRepository.observe()` declares `Flow<Profile>`, a type with no
failure case. `ProfileRepositoryImpl.observe()` appends
`.catch { error -> Log.e(TAG, ..., error) }` with no `emit`, so a
`profileDao.observe()` failure logs and lets the flow complete with zero
emissions; the collector sees a normally-completed empty flow, not a
declared failure. Four call sites collect it with `.first()`, which
throws `NoSuchElementException` on an empty, completed flow:
`WatchApp` in `MainActivity.kt` (`WatchDestination.MAIN`, line 237, and
`WatchDestination.PROJECTION`, line 255), `NavigationModule.kt:45`
inside `profileAlreadySynced` — where the `withTimeoutOrNull` wrapping it
only bounds a slow completion, not an exception thrown synchronously on
first collection — and `RaceRecordingRepositoryImpl.kt:105`, inside the
RUN-segment correction-factor branch, not named in the gap but found by
grep on the same `profileRepository.observe().first()` call shape. None
of the four catches `NoSuchElementException`; the one reached from
`WatchRaceNavigator`'s scope (`profileAlreadySynced`, via
`NavigationModule`) has no handler there either, so the exception is
uncaught.

## Expected

`ProfileRepository.observe()` declares a `Flow` whose element type
carries both the profile and a failure case of the interface's own
declared type (R75), and `ProfileRepositoryImpl.observe()`'s `.catch`
emits that failure case instead of completing silently on a
`profileDao.observe()` error.

Second gap — every current caller reads the old element type and must
be rewritten against the new one, each handling the failure case
explicitly instead of calling `.first()` on a possibly-empty flow: the
two `produceState` reads in `WatchApp` (`MainActivity.kt:237` and
`:255`), `NavigationModule.kt:45`'s `profileAlreadySynced` (still bounded
by `withTimeoutOrNull` per R19, but the exception path also needs
handling since the timeout alone does not cover it), and
`RaceRecordingRepositoryImpl.kt:105`'s read of the profile before
computing the correction factor.
